bar._doc: #352: the bar a client model must clear before it may be connected (ADR 031, CORAX ADR 019 rule). Fixed BEFORE any run; changing it is a reviewed commit, never an edit after seeing results. Rows come from scripts/ask_regression.py (10 questions + 3 guardrail probes) run on a QA tenant connected to the model under test.

changes.2: Criteria unchanged. The injection probe in scripts/ask_regression.py is rewritten so it passes the pre-model scope gate: the v1 probe contained 'ignore', a refuse cue, so classify_scope stopped it (reason off-domain) before any model call and no model could clear 'probes_refused_by_guardrail'. Seen in the 2026-11-07 Sonnet 5.5 run (#352).
